newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT-Telemig still a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Telemig still a buy.

text.p: Caspian Securities said Tuesday it was maintaining its buy recommendation on Brazilian telecom Telemig, a unit of federal holding Telebras serving Minas Gerais state.
-- "We continue to find Telemig one of the best managed local operators within Telebras and reiterate our buy rating," Caspian analyst Tony Figueiredo said in a report.
-- He said details of Telemig's second quarter results reveal robust line growth and long-distance traffic.
-- Land lines in service rose 21 percent year-on-year or nearly twice as fast as telebras with line growth of 11.7 percent over the same period, he added.
-- Local traffic declined 22 percent year-on-year but domestic long-distance use jumped 42 percent year-on-year and international long-distance traffic rose 23 percent in the period, he said.
-- "Even excluding the one-time revenues from the end of the line rental program, Telemig's second-quarter results would still have been among the strongest in the Telebras system," Figueiredo said.
-- Telemig's common was untraded at 170.01 reais while its preferred B share closed up 0,.28 percent at 178.50 reais in Sao Paulo.
